description: Upload a local file (video, image, audio, document; max 500 MB) and send it to a chat, with an optional caption. This sends a real message on the user's behalf: confirm the recipient and the file first.

chatID.description: Chat ID (or local chat ID) to send to

convert.description: Videos only. auto (default): re-encode with ffmpeg, if installed, when the video would play badly on phones (HEVC, 60 fps, full-range color, rotation metadata…). always / never force it.

fileName.description: File name shown to the recipient (defaults to the local name)

filePath.description: Absolute path of the file to send

text.description: Optional caption sent with the file

name: send_file
title: Send a file to a Beeper chat
